reason: The strings are quoted correctly and the reading of them is wrong, and the fix would reintroduce the exact jump round 2 removed. WHAT DRIVES TRUE. At ?v=light&state=loading&motion=settled, 1440x960, chromium: .coverage reads TASKS READING | TIMELINE READING | NOTES READING | READ 09:14, THURSDAY 16 JULY 2026 | LAB COUNTS AND AGES ARE LAB-AUTHORED | BOUND WORKSPACE, OWNER, READING DATE AND THE 9, and exactly two elements own a text node containing readingLong (.reading p at lately.html:944, the .coverage span at :954). That much is right. WHAT KILLS IT. (1) The stamp is not a completion receipt, and the error state proves it. Driven at ?state=error the same two stamps print at the same coordinates (reading line y=122.14, coverage y=583.88) beside TASKS DID NOT ANSWER | TIMELINE NOT READ | NOTES NOT READ. Three sources say the read failed and the fourth, in the same row and the same voice, prints 09:14, Thursday 16 July 2026 - the finding's structural complaint, verbatim, in a state where the read demonstrably did not happen. That is not an oversight: interaction-check.mjs:353-362 runs the anchored loop over full, partial, quiet, first-run AND error and asserts the instant is stated in each, while the separate error check at :1004-1013 counts stamps inside main only and passes at 0. The surface deliberately keeps the anchor when the read fails and deliberately keeps it out of the reading. So READ is not 'when it completed'; it is the instant everything relative on the screen resolves against, which is what lately.html:204-205 says it is. In loading that anchor is still load-bearing: TWELVE WEEKS sits immediately to its right in the same row, and twelve weeks is meaningless without an end. (2) Applied evenly the finding condemns the header it does not raise. The reading date is one of four bound facts, and the footer's own Bound stamp names them: workspace, owner, reading date and the 9. Driven in loading, .ws prints 'Harbour House weddings - Orla' at rgb(113,113,122) - the same ink, the same header, the same state as the stamp the seat calls a lie. Workspace and owner are no more 'held' by a state that is still reading than the reading date is. Both are bound, neither is read, and only one is filed. That is the test that killed bound-nine-prints-where-no-nine-was-read in r2. (3) Two supporting claims are false when driven. 'At full ink': the reading line computes to rgb(113,113,122), Geist Mono 11px 400, ink-3 - identical in all seven states, and the dim label voice. 'Above a page that has been emptied of every other fact': in loading, movementThree renders whole at full ink - .limit .t-head computes to rgb(17,17,17) - so the refusals, not the stamp, are the strongest text on that page. (4) Round 2's rule is honoured, not skipped. The rule at lately.html:1222-1226 is scoped to .sk-wrap because that is what the skeleton is - the same DOM with its ink out. The footer and the reading line are chrome, outside main and outside the skeleton, and the skeleton's own magnitudes ARE neutralised: bars to --h:46, meters to --f:0.4, dots evenly spaced, .record/.record-tag/.fortnight hidden, .sr lines removed, controls made inert, the whole block aria-hidden. Nothing regressed. WHY THE FIX IS WORSE. 'Make the Read entry a source like the other three' fails on its own terms: Read is not a source, it is an instant, and the row renders as READ READING - measured, all four widths. It is not a phrase in any of the three grammars on that strip. Meanwhile BOUND ... READING DATE AND THE 9 would keep claiming a bound reading date on a page that no longer prints one. And the fix's load-bearing promise - 'Both keep their box, their rank and their place, so no geometry moves when the data lands' - is measurably false at the width the brief calls the whole reading on a phone. Applying both strings in place at 390x900 and re-running the surface's own wrap measurement: .reading un-wraps (data-wrapped true to false, height 61.69px to 38.84px, the connector rule reappears and the interpunct separators vanish), .coverage drops from 5 rows to 4 (122.06px to 103.22px) and document height falls 2664 to 2622px - a 42px jump the moment the data lands, in a state built so the surface cannot jump when the data lands. At 768/1280/1440 nothing moves; at 390 everything below the header does. Severity is overstated on top of that: nothing untrue is asserted and nothing is visibly wrong, so refinement at most, and I do not think the refinement is worth taking.
sharpenedFix: Change nothing here. If the loading state is to say more about its own progress, do it where the state already speaks and where no geometry is at stake: the sources side of the strip already says READING three times, and the live region at lately.html:1027 already says 'Loading this reading.' The one thing genuinely worth doing is closing the gate hole this finding walks through, which is worth more than the copy change: interaction-check.mjs:353 runs the anchored loop over five states and silently omits loading and empty, so nothing anywhere asserts what the chrome prints in those two. Add them to that list with the floor they deserve - anchored >= 1 in every state that renders the shell, since the anchor is chrome, not a reading - and add a positive assertion beside it that in loading the anchor appears ONLY in the chrome and never inside .sk-wrap, mirroring the main-scoped error check at :1004-1013. That polices the invariant the seat is reaching for, and it cannot go vacuous: it fails the moment a magnitude leaks out of the skeleton into the anchored count.
breaks: If the fix were taken as written: the 390 reflow above (reading line un-wraps, coverage loses a row, document shortens 42px) reintroduces the load-on-arrival jump; READ READING ships as visible copy in the strip voice; the Bound stamp names a reading date the page no longer shows; and SOURCES gains a fourth key that is not a source, which derive-fixture.mjs does not guard and which every future state must remember. The behaviour gate would NOT catch any of it - loading is absent from the anchored loop - which is the actual defect underneath this finding. If the sharpened gate assertions are taken instead, re-run interaction-check.mjs in full (the anchored loop grows from 5 states to 7) and confirm the empty state still passes at 2 occurrences; audit.mjs is untouched, since no colour, weight, family, size or leading changes.
